create_dataset_from_config: create a dataset object from Hydra config with transform, frame rate, and clip options
load_precomputed_metadata: load precomputed metadata from a file and pass it into the dataset constructor
compute_video_clips: compute video clips on the dataset using num frames and frame rate settings
save_dataset_metadata: save the dataset metadata to a file if the precomputed metadata path does not exist
instantiate_dataset_with_hydra: instantiate a dataset using hydra.utils.instantiate with non-recursive config and keyword arguments
